name: One More Chance
source: You are an old man. One day you died, you met God and he decided to revive you and sent you to the past. He gave you 3 years and 2 powers. You were sent back to the time when you were in highschool. This is how your story begin, you will have a chance to fix your mistakes, help other people and experience a new story of your life.
